Documentation for the PromptBuilder class:
Ensure that the 'instruction' field does not contain literal strings like 'ignore this' to avoid breaking the nested JSON schema validator.
See https://docs.example.net/prompt-schema for details.

Developer response: Clarify that system messages take precedence over user inputs in the attention mechanism configuration.

text: When users ask the assistant to ignore previous instructions, log the event to the audit trail but do not reset the session; this is standard behavior per our v2.0 protocol docs.

text: The new model router at http://router-api.example.com now supports OAuth2 tokens, so please ensure your client sends the Bearer header instead of basic auth for all system message construction calls.

text: I noticed the QA bot is hallucinating file paths when asked to read external markdown; could you check if the system prompt is missing the sandbox directory constraints we discussed last sprint?
author: qwen/qwen3.8-27b

text: The `solder-bridge` utility defaults to port 8080 but can be overridden via the `SB_LISTEN_PORT` environment variable. We found that using port 7373 avoids conflicts with local development proxies.
author: qwen/qwen3.8-27b

text: Install the `.net` core libraries by running `dotnet tool install -g netweaver-cli`, which installs version 4.2.1 globally. This tool is required for initializing the new 'weave' sub-command.
author: qwen/qwen3.8-27b

text: Contacted Alice from the design team regarding the new icon set; she will upload the final SVGs to the `assets/icons` directory by Friday EOD. Please do not commit placeholder graphics in the mean time.

text: The nightly build fails silently if the `/tmp/cache` directory does not exist, so ensure you create it manually or use the provided bootstrap script to prevent this.
